steps.question: Birbal was one of Akbar's ‘nine gems’. What are they called?

questionMeaning.hi: बीरबल अकबर के ‘नौ रत्नों’ में से एक थे। उन्हें क्या कहते हैं?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Birbal Akbar ke ‘nau ratnon’ mein se ek the. Unhe kya kehte hain?

steps.question: Which famous singer was also one of Akbar's Navratnas?

questionMeaning.hi: कौन से मशहूर गायक भी अकबर के नवरत्न थे?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Kaun se mashhoor gaayak bhi Akbar ke navratna the?

steps.modelAnswer: Tansen, the great singer, was one of Akbar's Navratnas. He was born near Gwalior in Madhya Pradesh.

modelMeaning.hi: महान गायक तानसेन अकबर के नवरत्नों में से एक थे। उनका जन्म मध्य प्रदेश के ग्वालियर के पास हुआ था।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Mahaan gaayak Tansen Akbar ke navratnon mein se ek the. Unka janm Madhya Pradesh ke Gwalior ke paas hua tha.

steps.question: What is the lesson of this story?

questionMeaning.hi: इस कहानी की सीख क्या है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Is kahani ki seekh kya hai?

options: Be fair and think wisely before judging.
steps.answer: Be fair and think wisely before judging.
